{"prompt":"You are the brainstorm worker for a C -> Rust translation of a small TOTP (time-based one-time password) library.

Workspace: /workspace (your working directory). The source C codebase is in /workspace/src/ (files: totp.c, totp.h, std.c, std.h, main.c, test.c, Makefile, README.md, LICENSE.md).

Read the source files first. Then write /workspace/plan.md containing:
1. A short strategy paragraph for translating this C codebase to Rust (crate layout, which files map to which Rust modules, how to handle the freestanding std.c/std.h, how to expose the CLI, how to port the tests).
2. A list of the core difficulties and candidate approaches (e.g. SIZE_MAX overflow checks, the `buf` clobbering contract of sha1, the `__attribute__((visibility("default")))` export macro, the base32 edge cases, the test harness differences between C assert and Rust #[test]).

Do NOT write any Rust code yet. Only write plan.md. Then report back with a summary of the core difficulties you identified."}
